title: Two-flavor hard-wall chiral Model A
summary: An exact-endpoint Chebyshev and independent adaptive-collocation reproduction of the seven rounded Model A entries and the GMOR limit in the two-flavor hard-wall chiral model of Erlich, Katz, Son, and Stephanov.

source.title: QCD and a Holographic Model of Hadrons

conventions.name: bulk model
conventions.value: Two flavors, SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R, fixed AdS5 slice, A_z = 0, and AdS radius one
conventions.rationale: This is the source bottom-up effective model, not a top-down construction or a first-principles QCD calculation.

conventions.name: dimensionless coordinate and scalar background
conventions.value: u = z/z_m and v(u) = (m_q z_m) u + (sigma z_m^3) u^3
conventions.rationale: Fixes all powers and units in the spectral equations.

conventions.name: normalizable-mode endpoints
conventions.rationale: These are the source UV normalizability and phenomenological IR-wall conditions.

conventions.name: regulated axial zero mode
conventions.value: A_0(epsilon)=1 at epsilon_z=1e-10 MeV^-1 and A_0'(1)=0, retaining the full v(u)^2
conventions.rationale: At nonzero m_q the full source equation contains a u^2 log(u) UV term, so the public-source numerical regulator is explicit.

parameters.name: IR-wall inverse position
parameters.description: Printed Model A input; HoloForge performs no refit.

parameters.name: chiral condensate cube root
parameters.description: Printed Model A input in the source convention.

parameters.name: five-dimensional gauge coupling
parameters.description: OPE matching g5^2=12 pi^2/N_c at N_c=3.

parameters.name: spectral degrees
parameters.description: Frozen refinement sequence; N=96 is reported.

equations.description: Normalizable a1-sector eigenproblem and zero-momentum axial equation.

equations.expression: u^2 phi''-u phi'+g5^2 v^2(pi-phi)=0; -lambda phi'+g5^2(v/u)^2 pi'=0
equations.description: Coupled generalized eigenproblem for the pion and longitudinal axial mode.
Leading small-quark-mass relation tested under four mass halvings.

observables.name: Model A masses
observables.extraction: Lowest source-blind admissible positive eigenvalue in each normalizable sector.

observables.name: decay constants
observables.extraction: Regulated axial zero-mode slope and exact factored UV endpoint limits.

observables.name: rho-pion-pion coupling
observables.extraction: Canonical pion-density overlap with the normalized lowest vector mode.

observables.name: GMOR ratio
observables.extraction: m_pi^2 f_pi^2/(2 m_q sigma) at four fixed quark-mass factors.

acceptance_criteria: The protected vector benchmark passes and the lowest vector eigenvalue agrees with the first J_0 zero within 1e-6.
Operator-scaled twice-denser equation residuals are at most 1e-7; endpoint residuals are at most 1e-8; normalization residuals are at most 1e-8.
All seven final N=80 to N=96 changes are at most 2e-4 with the frozen ordering rule.
Finite-cutoff axial and pion quantities change by at most 2e-4 and agree with the N=96 route within 1e-3.
DOP853 and solve_bvp f_pi values agree within 1e-7 and the analytic m_q^2 log(2) slope within 1e-5.
All seven rounded Model A entries agree within 1%, and the final GMOR error is at most 1% with monotonic approach.
Duplicate physical outputs agree within 1e-11, and JSON, CLI, schema, artifact, privacy, and regression checks pass.

tests.expected: All source, spectral, independent-route, Table II, GMOR, determinism, and artifact gates pass.
The registered verifier returns strict passing JSON with the owner-approved result review state and bounded scope.

claims.statement: The displayed hard-wall chiral equations, Model A inputs, Table II values, and GMOR relation are established in the cited public source.
claims.evidence: Erlich et al., arXiv:hep-ph/0501128v2, the equations and table listed in this card.

claims.statement: The HoloForge spectral and independent routes reproduce all seven rounded Model A entries and the declared GMOR limit within the frozen contract.
claims.evidence: Generated JSON, CSV, graphic, and automated gates in tests/test_hard_wall_chiral.py.

limitations: The hard IR wall and Neumann conditions are phenomenological inputs, not derived QCD confinement.
m_pi, m_rho, and f_pi are source fit targets; only the other four Table II rows are source predictions.
The printed Model A parameters are rounded, so the one-percent source-table gate is separate from numerical convergence.
The public-source f_pi prescription is explicitly regulated because the full nonzero-m_q equation contains a UV logarithm; no renormalized epsilon-to-zero claim is made.
The truncated action omits higher operators such as F^3 that can affect the rho-pion-pion coupling.
The benchmark excludes Model B, strange quarks, baryons, glueballs, anomaly terms, finite temperature or density, and improved holographic QCD.
Passing reproduces the selected effective-model calculation and does not empirically validate QCD or establish phenomenological precision.

Following EKSS, the chiral scalar's operator normalization is implicitly a = 1, so the printed m_q = 2.29 MeV and sigma = (327 MeV)^3 are model-convention parameters, not QCD's quark mass and condensate. Cherman, Cohen and Werbos (Phys. Rev. C 79, 045203 (2009)) find that large-N_c matching requires a = sqrt(N_c)/(2 pi), which gives m_q = 8.3 MeV and sigma = (213 MeV)^3 from the same fit. The model fixes only a*m_q and sigma/a, so the GMOR product m_q*sigma is convention-independent; neither parameter carries QCD's renormalization-scale dependence.
The implementation and record are AI-assisted; Xin-Yi Liu approved the numerical result and model-card provenance on 2026-08-20 without widening the stated support or publication scope.
